# Lingo7

> Lingo7 is a mobile app (iOS and Android) for learning a language by reading real books. It shows any book as parallel text with instant translation, native-narrated audio, tap-to-translate word cards, and spaced repetition for the words you save. It supports 49 languages, and you can import your own EPUB, FB2, or PDF books.

Publisher: SEYU LLC. Support: support@lingoseven.com. As of July 2026 the app is free to start, with a premium subscription for unlimited reading.

## App

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6471030440): iOS app
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.doublereading): Android app

## Free tools

- [All tools](https://lingoseven.com/tools/): 12 free tools, no sign-up
- [CEFR level test](https://lingoseven.com/tools/cefr-level-test/): find your level A1 to C2
- [Vocabulary size test](https://lingoseven.com/tools/vocabulary-size-estimator/): estimate how many words you know
- [How long to learn a language](https://lingoseven.com/tools/how-long-to-learn-a-language/): FSI-based hour estimates
- [Reading level recommender](https://lingoseven.com/tools/reading-level-recommender/): real books matched to your CEFR level
